title: Paul McCartney book signing for Hey Grandude! in London | 2019
content:
Paul McCartney took part in a book signing for his children’s book Hey Grandude! on 6 September 2019.

Quite a queue for the @PaulMcCartney signing at @WaterstonesPicc, with two hours still to go. pic.twitter.com/mCRIf1MAPo

— The Beatles Bible ? (@beatlesbible) September 6, 2019

The signing took place at Waterstones in Piccadilly, London. Also present was the book’s illustrator Kathryn Durst.

The event began with McCartney reading Hey Grandude! to a group of local schoolchildren. He then signed copies for ticket holders.

Eek! pic.twitter.com/Fx6MgSgbrP

— The Beatles Bible ? (@beatlesbible) September 6, 2019

Just 150 tickets went on sale on 12 August, and sold out within one minute. The price was £14 and included a copy of the book.

Ticket holders were able to bring up to two children aged 12 or under, and those doing so were admitted into the signing earlier than child-free attendees. All were instructed to leave bags, cameras, and mobile phones in a drop zone, and McCartney only signed copies of the book.

Ah, that was great. I shook his hand and we had a little chat about his recent holiday in the Hamptons. "In Long Island, you know. It was a bit of a Hey Grandude holiday with all the family." pic.twitter.com/e9vVG7unP7

— The Beatles Bible ? (@beatlesbible) September 6, 2019
